customer_updates.name: Suraj Parui
customer_updates.text: Hi I have been going to this supermart for years now and it's been an amazing place throughout. However I did have one bad interaction a few days back. I needed to get a cardboard box for some personal use and I went in to ask if I could buy one of the empty product boxes. The staff were helpful. I found a box and they said ask the cashier if it's possible to buy. I was just about to start talking to the cashier that an (old male) security guard called me over away from the cashier towards the exit (I was away from the exit door, it was he who called me over) I told him I asked the staff and I was going to ask the cashier. He asked me to hand over the empty box and I tell him I was going to show it to the cashier only to ask to buy. He insisted so I gave it to him. Then he says "Give me 10 rs" now let me be very clear. I don't have a problem giving money for the box. It was my plan to do so. But does he think he is the manager that I need to pay HIM money to buy something? I was polite and I explained that I don't have a problem paying as long it's the cashier he raises him voice and takes me over to one staff member who weighs and packs grains and tells him "We sell boxes for 10 rs" as if he's the store manager. He's a damn security guard. And the staff nods along to not make a scene. Again it's not about 10 rs. I come here to buy my groceries and pay 2 to 3 thousand weekly. And I did nothing without asking the nice staff. This was very disappointing and rude behaviour from his guard (especially over 10 rs)

Multiple counters are present but only 1–2 are operational, causing long and unnecessary queues. Staff repeatedly say counters are “closed” — then why is the store open without proper checkout support?
There is no express counter for customers with fewer items, which is basic for any large store.

featured_reviews.name: Vinod Dubey
featured_reviews.review_text:
Big Bazar is a retain chain of hypermarkets, discount department stores and grocery stores. This particular Big Bazar is really big. It has all the other sister chains like Fashion at Big Bazar (fbb), Food Bazar et cetera also here. You can find everything that you will need for your house and yourself under one roof here, from home decor, electronic appliances, furniture, toys, cosmetics, groceries to kitchen utensils. Also, everything is well managed and maintained. However, one thing that I find they can improve is to have more support staff who can guide customers. This is precisely why I have deducted one star from the rating. I would also advice them to keep chairs or sofas or make some sort of sitting arrangement in every section or department, because this store is really huge, one really gets tired if you check out every department, especially if you are with kids and elderly. Just a thought. I was also satisfied with the discounts that were on offer. At the same time, if they can up the discounts and offers in their kitchen utensils section that would be great.
Overall it really is a happening place to come shop at. If get hungry or thirsty while shopping, refreshments are also available, you will have to pay for them though..

featured_reviews.name: Oh Blue
featured_reviews.review_text:
Nestled in the bustling lanes of Matunga East lies a gem that effortlessly marries the culinary delights of delectable chaat with the convenience of a well-stocked supermarket. This establishment exudes an air of hospitality, anchored by its courteous and exceptionally professional staff. Their demeanor is a testament to the ethos of customer-centric service, characterized by prompt responses, genuine warmth, and an unwavering commitment to delivering nothing short of excellence.

The products offered here, whether the curated supermarket goods or the freshly prepared culinary items, are of impeccable quality. Freshness takes center stage, ensuring an experience that is as authentic as it is gratifying. The chaat offerings are nothing short of a gastronomic revelation. Every bite is a harmonious symphony of flavors, masterfully crafted with a keen eye on hygiene and presentation. Contrary to certain reviews that have alluded to an overtly spicy palate, the dishes here are artfully tailored to individual preferences, striking a fine balance between zest and subtlety. The food, inherently flavorful, is a perfect blend of textures and tastes, catering to a wide array of palates.

In summation, this establishment is a haven for those seeking a holistic dining and shopping experience. Its unparalleled service, quality-driven approach, and attention to detail make it a place I am eager to revisit. For connoisseurs of refined flavors and exemplary service, this is undoubtedly a destination worth frequenting.

featured_reviews.name: Viraj Mehta
featured_reviews.review_text: Very good place for a quick bite. Enjoy delicious Bhel, & other chats at reasonable price. Only drawback, you will have to either stand & eat or take it back home. Worth visiting. Don't miss the Panipuri. Usually crowded on holidays. Timing is 4:00PM to 8:00PM.
